006package dev.metaschema.core.model;
007
008import java.util.Collection;
009import java.util.Map;
010
011import dev.metaschema.core.model.impl.DefaultContainerModelSupport;
012import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
013
014/**
015 * Common interface for model container support classes.
016 *
017 * @param <MI>
018 *          the model instance Java type
019 * @param <NMI>
020 *          the named model instance Java type
021 * @param <FI>
022 *          the field instance Java type
023 * @param <AI>
024 *          the assembly instance Java type
025 */
026public interface IContainerModelSupport<
027    MI extends IModelInstance,
028    NMI extends INamedModelInstance,
029    FI extends IFieldInstance,
030    AI extends IAssemblyInstance> {
031
032  /**
033   * Get an empty, immutable container.
034   *
035   * @param <MI>
036   *          the model instance Java type
037   * @param <NMI>
038   *          the named model instance Java type
039   * @param <FI>
040   *          the field instance Java type
041   * @param <AI>
042   *          the assembly instance Java type
043   * @return the empty container
044   */
045  @NonNull
046  static <
047      MI extends IModelInstance,
048      NMI extends INamedModelInstance,
049      FI extends IFieldInstance,
050      AI extends IAssemblyInstance> IContainerModelSupport<MI, NMI, FI, AI> empty() {
051    return DefaultContainerModelSupport.empty();
052  }
053
054  /**
055   * Get a listing of all model instances.
056   *
057   * @return the listing
058   */
059  @NonNull
060  Collection<MI> getModelInstances();
061
062  /**
063   * Get a mapping of all named model instances, mapped from their effective name
064   * to the instance.
065   *
066   * @return the mapping
067   */
068  @NonNull
069  Map<Integer, NMI> getNamedModelInstanceMap();
070
071  /**
072   * Get a mapping of all field instances, mapped from their effective name to the
073   * instance.
074   *
075   * @return the mapping
076   */
077  @NonNull
078  Map<Integer, FI> getFieldInstanceMap();
079
080  /**
081   * Get a mapping of all assembly instances, mapped from their effective name to
082   * the instance.
083   *
084   * @return the mapping
085   */
086  @NonNull
087  Map<Integer, AI> getAssemblyInstanceMap();
088}
